title: Bee Buzz
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 3 "robins gyre 1½ while larks cross clockwise to meet partner on the other side of set" isn't drawn yet.
Row 1 "circle left 2 places larks roll a way with neighbor across set · roll" can't start from where the dancers are: The pair stands along the set, so the roll cannot go across it.
Row 2 "circle left 2 places and roll a way partner along set ( left to right to swap) · roll" can't start from where the dancers are: The pair stands across the set, so the roll cannot go along it.

unparsed.text: robins gyre 1½ while larks cross clockwise to meet partner on the other side of set
unparsed.why: The gyre row adds "while men cross clockwise to meet partner on the other side of set".

choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
